create_BaseOptions_parser: create a BaseOptions instance and call initialize to define CLI arguments for pix2pix training
gather_options_BaseOptions: call gather_options on a BaseOptions subclass to parse and collect model-specific command line arguments
parse_BaseOptions: call parse on a BaseOptions subclass to fully parse options, process suffix, and set GPU device IDs
